GEO submission draft covering two Seq-Well S3 single-cell RNA-seq libraries (D.SEQ-221031SHA-65-PUB / SRR22257169 and D.SEQ-221031SHA-67-PUB / SRR22257167) derived from two lung granulomas of a CD8-depleted, M. tuberculosis-infected cynomolgus macaque (subject 28818).
